decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, Central slot 2, North slot 3, South slot 4
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: Central moved 0.35 line heights, North moved 0.18 line heights, South moved 0.17 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$140K total donations per day”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$140K total donations per day”
time axis: the first and last labels kept 3 pt clear of the outer dividers, centred on their slots, which start 4.2 pt in from the left divider and end 0.0 pt before the right one
time axis: row 1 full, every third label, restarting in each group
time axis: “1” (Nov. 1, 2022) closer than 3 pt to the divider between two groups: kept on its slot, with a halo in the page colour round its letters, which interrupts the divider
time axis on two levels: row 2 Oct. 2022, Nov. 2022, dividers between the groups
the title wraps onto two lines

source.shows: the same at 260 pt: every second day labelled, restarting at the first of each month (16, 18 … 30 | 1, 3 … 9), never rotated (the book's narrow version, s. 0100)
